module.name: RTT Validator Bot
module.summary: Triadic conformance engine: validates schemas, pipelines, golden examples, operator lineage, drift, and triadic invariants across all RTT bots.

module.name: RTT-Validator
module.summary: The RTT meta-engine that checks correctness, consistency, and conformance across all bots.
module.purpose: Validate RTT modules by checking schema conformance, pipeline correctness, operator lineage, drift stability, risk signatures, and golden example fidelity.
module.audience: Framework maintainers, engine integrators, diagnostics systems

input_spec.notes: Validator consumes the entire module bundle.

steps: Lumen: extract structural signals from manifest + schema
Hephaestus: classify regime of module components (local, structural, continuity)
Aurion: check ancestry consistency (operator lineage, pipeline order, collapse signatures)
Harmonia: compute triadic conformance score for the module
StateEmitter: emit JSON conforming to module_validator_schema.json

examples.description: A full RTT module bundle that passes all conformance checks.

context.drift: Validator drift is structural: modules must remain aligned.
